instincts.trigger: Connecting a PyQt slot that will emit the same signal it handles
instincts.action: Check the handler body for emit of the connected signal; if present, remove it or emit a distinct signal; verify with a full-circuit search of consumers

instincts.trigger: A pytest run passes but -s output contains tracebacks
instincts.action: Treat as a hidden defect; traceback printing from PyQt slots means swallowed exceptions, not passing code

instincts.trigger: Re-running any script that overwrites its own report file
instincts.action: Copy report and raw data to dated backups first; record ambient CPU load during the run for the delta explanation
Avoid $pid/$PID (read-only); use descriptive names; expect 'Cannot overwrite variable' as the symptom
Prove pre-existence at prior commits via worktree before fixing; classify as stale vs defect; document in Known_Issues.md
